card.name: Film-coated tablets and swallowing whole
card.fires_on: The word right after "film" (the "-co" of film-coated, or "coating") in tablet descriptions, and words like "whole" after "swallow tablets". Also device or sensor words in temperature-measurement text.

modes.label: Film-coated tablets
modes.description: The "-co" or "coating" right after "film" in tablet formulation text.
modes.example: The recommended adult dosage of ISENTRESS film<<-co>>ated tablets is displayed in Table 1

modes.label: Swallow whole
modes.description: The word "whole" after instructions to swallow tablets.
modes.example: Swallow tablets<< whole>> with water. Do not break, crush

modes.label: Data-logging instruments
modes.description: Words for sensors or devices that record temperature and other measurements in science web text.
modes.example: Scientists must come up to the NWHI and retrieve these<< devices>> in order to obtain the data.
